basic_info.name: Shree Balaji Group
basic_info.description: Established in 2005, Shree Balaji Group has grown beyond its age and successfully carved a niche for itself in the real estate market. Many prestigious awards and industry honors have been bestowed on several Balaji projects and the group has become a flag bearer for luxury living and elite business hubs in Gujarat. Our quest for excellence and commitment to create world class infrastructure has paved the way in transforming the premium luxury living spaces and we have delivered some of India’s finest retail and residential landmarks.Shree Balaji Group is among the fastest growing real estate companies in India and has also ventured into other sectors such as retail, hospitality, and entertainment. With over 80 lakh square feet of premium residential and commercial spaces successfully delivered through our award winning projects, our journey in the real estate sector continues with several high-end projects in progress. Our vision is to raise the bar with every project we undertake and deliver world-class premium luxury spaces in a sustainable ecosystem and transform the way people perceive quality. With great power comes great responsibility, and Shree Balaji Group takes charity and social responsibility as seriously as their flagship real estate projects. We are running a slum rehabilitation project in Vadodara in collaboration with Gujarat Govt.’s PPP model scheme, and there are other lesser known but equally important projects in progress at various levels.  Under the Vadodara project we are rehabilitating the slum dwellers and providing them with accommodation and a cleaner, healthier lifestyle to create a progressive and self-sustainable community. We continue to work with increased zeal and dedication to create new quality benchmarks through our projects and build a rich legacy of unparalleled excellence.
industries: Real Estate and Equipment Rental Services

basic_info.description: Founded in 2009, Shree Balaji Knits is a leading manufacturer and supplier of premium knitted fabrics based in Gurugram, India. Our fabrics are designed for comfort, durability, and style - serving diverse industries such as casualwear, sportswear, activewear and fashion garments.At Shree Balaji Knits, we combine state-of-the-art knitting technology with strict quality control to ensure consistent texture, colorfastness and superior finishing in every roll of fabric. Our in-house production and skilled workforce allow for customized orders, timely delivery and competitive pricing.Driven by the vision of delivering “quality you can feel,” we continue to expand our capabilities and embrace sustainable practices to meet global standards. Whether you are a startup brand or an established label, Shree Balaji Knits is your reliable fabric partner, where innovation meets craftsmanship.

basic_info.name: Shree Balaji Netralay
basic_info.description: Shree Balaji Netralaya is a 10 bedded Eye Hospital, started on 10th July, 2016 by Dr. Shashi Mohanka to provide best Eye Care Facilities under one roof. Dr. Suvesh Kumar, Dr. Sunil Agarwal & Dr. Nirmal Kumar are other visiting Consultants at Shree Balaji Netralaya, Patna.Dr. Shashi is a super-specialist for eye surgery and eye-care. He has had a very successful career with tons of experience. He has worked with leading eye hospitals like Agarwal eye hospital, Vasan eye hospital in Selum for over 10 years. After having served as senior phoco-surgeon in Vilas eye hospital in Patna for a good seven years, he has been now heading the position of Director in Balaji netralaya in Patna. He has been acclaimed for several successful innovations and experiments in the field of cataract treatment. He has a lot of “FIRSTS” accredited to his name.He has pioneered the use of 2.2mm Pre-load torick lens in a cornea replacement procedure; the first surgeon acclaimed to do so in the whole of Asia.He has volunteered to test over forty thousand people in several eye-ailment-detection camps in the last six years “absolutely free of charges”. He has also treated over 8500 patients with cataract problems for free. He has been recognized for both his expertise and free eye-care services by many social, charitable institutions, organization and official state bodies. Agrasen Seva Nyaas has recognized him with the award title of “Samaj Gaurav”. He has been felicitated by the Chief Minister of Bihar, Shri Nitish Kumar as well his Excellency, the Governor of Bihar for his relentless efforts in the field of eye-care.
